title: The Secret to Ending All Wars Is the Truth We Already Know
author: Mike Brooks Ph.D.
summary: Personal Perspective: At the heart of every major spiritual teaching is the call to love our neighbors as ourselves. Living this truth we already know could end all wars.

images.alt: The Secret to Ending All Wars Is the Truth We Already Know
images.caption: Cover Image

images.alt: Every major wisdom tradition points us in the same direction: outward. The Bullseye of Life is to expand our circles of compassion from self to family, to community, to all humanity, to all of existence—until we embrace our interconnectedness fully.

This is what the Bullseye of Life looks like when fully lived—every boundary dissolved and every circle open. When we expand our circles of compassion to include everyone, even our enemies, a miracle happens: We have no enemies.

# The Secret to Ending All Wars Is the Truth We Already Know

> Personal Perspective: At the heart of every major spiritual teaching is the call to love our neighbors as ourselves. Living this truth we already know could end all wars.
